_drafted_note: Drafted 2026-08-23 from the world's OWN archipelago.json, README and releases. No field is filled in from memory or from what other games on the same platform do.
_platform_source: README: the hack is loaded in Project64, Mupen64 or RetroArch -- Nintendo 64 emulators
description: Super Mario 64 ROM hacks as a multiworld. You bring the hack; the world shuffles its stars.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game -- no text copied from the game itself
_checks_verified_note: Stays false until somebody has played it through London. Built is not tested.
_requires_source: the player supplies both a Super Mario 64 ROM and the hack they want to play
_mod_kind_source: the world is a framework for playing Super Mario 64 ROM HACKS -- the player brings their own hack. It runs on the same console as the original and stays under Nintendo 64 in the filter.

client.name: SM64 Romhack Client
client._kind_source: the world drives the emulator itself through its own client
client._protocol_source: the world opens its own connection to the game -- no emulator memory protocol is involved, so London carries nothing but the launch. Recorded as "self" rather than naming a bridge we do not use.

apworld._source: the repository's own releases page; latest v1.1.10 carries sm64hacks.apworld

_install_kind_source: NOT a one-click install, and the card must not pretend otherwise. Per the README the player must first produce a .jsml layout for their hack with SM64StarDisplay, then turn it into a json on the author's own website. London can do neither step, so install_kind is manual rather than apworld_only.
setup: Load your hack in Project64, Mupen64 or RetroArch and open SM64StarDisplay to get its .jsml layout.
Turn that .jsml into a json at http://dnvic.com/ArchipelagoGenerator/index.html.
Download sm64hacks.apworld from the release into Archipelago's custom_worlds folder.
Use your generated json when you build the seed.

patch._source: the setup guide describes no patching step

_patch_extension_source: world source not downloaded -- repo policy is addresses only. Flagged in every build until somebody reads it.

world_by.name: DNVIC
world_by._source: the repository that publishes this world, read 2026-08-23
world_by._licence_source: read from the repository's LICENSE file 2026-08-23 -- the MIT text Archipelago itself carries (LLCoolDave, Berserker66, CaitSith2, LegendaryLinux). The world lives in a fork of Archipelago and inherits its licence file.

credits.game_by: Nintendo for the base game; each hack is its own author's work
credits._note: Super Mario 64 is Nintendo's and is never distributed here, and neither is any hack of it. The player supplies both. The Archipelago world is DNVIC's. Only the plugin itself is by solida1987.

_warning: The world's own README states that use and discussion of this apworld is no longer allowed in the main Archipelago server. That is their community's rule, not a legal or technical problem, and nobody has asked us to remove it -- but support questions must go to the author's own Discord, which the README links.
